name: Prose
description: Self-contained long-form typography for rendered markdown/MDX: headings, links, lists, code, tables, quotes and figures.
designIntent: Content sites need consistent article typography without depending on the Tailwind typography plugin. Prose styles rendered HTML via child selectors, so any remark/MDX pipeline can drop output inside.

props.name: size
props.description: Type scale for body and headings.

examples.title: Article body
examples.description: Wrap MDX/remark output; keep Shiki/KaTeX as-is.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use prose for app UI
antiPatterns.explanation: Prose targets article content; forms and dashboards use Text/Heading.

accessibility.implementation: scroll-mt offsets headings under sticky headers
accessibility.userRequirements: Generate heading ids in your markdown pipeline

compositionRules.relationship: Pair long articles with a TOC + useScrollSpy
